import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
#check_failure MvPolynomial.taylor_rename
noncomputable section
namespace MvPolynomial.TaylorRenameRaw
variable {σ τ υ R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
def shift (α : σ → R) : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
  aeval fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)
theorem afterRename (f : σ → τ) (g : τ → A) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    aeval g (rename f P) = aeval (g ∘ f) P :=
  aeval_rename f g P
theorem afterSubstitution (f : τ → υ) (g : σ → MvPolynomial τ R)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    rename f (aeval g P) = aeval (fun j ↦ rename f (g j)) P :=
  comp_aeval_apply g (rename f) P
theorem oldForm (f : σ → τ) (α : τ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    shift α (rename f P) = rename f (shift (α ∘ f) P) := by
  change aeval (fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)) (rename f P) =
    rename f (aeval (fun j ↦ X j + C (α (f j))) P)
  rw [aeval_rename, comp_aeval_apply]
  apply congrArg (fun g : σ → MvPolynomial τ R ↦ aeval g P)
  funext j
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_add, rename_X, rename_C]
#print axioms afterRename
#print axioms afterSubstitution
#print axioms oldForm
#print oldForm
end MvPolynomial.TaylorRenameRaw

theorem MvPolynomial.TaylorRenameRaw.oldForm.{u_1, u_2, u_4} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_4}
  [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ) (α : τ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (shift α) ((rename f) P) = (rename f) ((shift (α ∘ f)) P) :=
fun {σ} {τ} {R} [CommSemiring R] f α P ↦
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = (rename f) ((aeval fun j ↦ X j + C (α (f j))) P))
          (aeval_rename f (fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)) P)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (aeval ((fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)) ∘ f)) P = _a)
            (comp_aeval_apply (fun j ↦ X j + C (α (f j))) (rename f) P)))
        (congrArg (fun g ↦ (aeval g) P)
          (funext fun j ↦
            of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (Eq (X (f j) + C (α (f j))))
                  (Eq.trans (map_add (rename f) (X j) (C (α (f j))))
                    (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (rename_X f j)) (rename_C f (α (f j))))))
                (eq_self (X (f j) + C (α (f j)))))))))
